source: Raw sf.ethereum.type.v2.Block captures (DETAILLEVEL_EXTENDED) from a Pinax Firehose endpoint, one block per request, fetched on 2026-10-17 for the v0.7.4 investigation.
extraction: Cut at the protobuf wire level by a scratch script kept outside the repository: the listed transaction_traces (Block field 10) keep their exact bytes, as does every other top-level field (header, hash, number, system calls and block-level records), in the original order. No field edits.
rows: Every row map_events emits for the fixture, by contract and holder, as v0.7.4 gives it. Each fixture row was checked offline to equal the row v0.7.4 gives for the same pair on the full source block; added_since_v073 lists the pairs v0.7.3 does not emit on the fixture.
rpc_era: Read-only, 2026-10-17: the RPC-era database (mainnet:evm-balances@v0.3.3 or bsc:evm-balances@v0.3.3), table historical_erc20_balances_state, interval_min = 1. For each fixture row, the 1-minute bar of the block's minute is read at the block when the bar starts (open) or ends (close) there; holders without such a bar are not listed.

cases.selection: every WBNB transaction (only the bot transaction 1)
cases.demonstrates: on a Block.ver 3 producer, which never cuts call data, a bot transaction CALLs WBNB balanceOf four times with 68-byte keyed inputs (calls 2, 3, 28 and 29); v0.7.3 dropped WBNB for the block, v0.7.4 reads them

cases.selection: every WETH transaction with one call, and transaction 27
cases.demonstrates: tx 27 (Block.ver 3) STATICCALLs WETH balanceOf(0xed777775...) twice with 64-byte inputs (calls 2 and 15); v0.7.3 dropped WETH for the block, v0.7.4 reads them

cases.selection: transaction 50 and the first ten USDT transactions with one call whose holders appear in no other USDT transaction of the block
cases.demonstrates: tx 50 (Block.ver 4) STATICCALLs USDT balanceOf with a 28-byte input (call 2), which TetherToken (solc 0.4.18) answers with balanceOf(0) of the zero-extended argument; v0.7.3 dropped USDT for the block, v0.7.4 reads it only to veto

cases.selection: every USDT transaction with one call, and the bot transaction 97
cases.demonstrates: a bot transaction (tx 97, Block.ver 5) CALLs balanceOf(0x1dd00b11...) of USDT, USDC and WETH with 68-byte inputs (pad(holder) and a leftover word of its transfer buffer) that return the stored word; v0.7.3 dropped all three tokens for the block on the input length, v0.7.4 reads each as balanceOf(input[16..36]). The USDT read (call 38) is keyed and the USDC read (call 9) is not

cases.selection: every USDC transaction with at most two calls (a proxied transfer), and the bot transaction 166
cases.demonstrates: tx 166 (Block.ver 5) CALLs USDC balanceOf(0x52852bd8...) with a 68-byte input and no recorded preimage (unkeyed, as 5.5.0 producers record a read of an unchanged holder), returning the stored 5,769,348, and WETH balanceOf with a 68-byte keyed input (call 91); v0.7.3 dropped both tokens for the block, v0.7.4 keeps their rows and the unkeyed read only vetoes

cases.selection: every USDT transaction with one call, and the destroyBlackFunds transaction 135
cases.demonstrates: destroyBlackFunds(0x5ff793c0...) in tx 135 call 2 zeroes 206,582.903646 USDT with DestroyedBlackFunds; the holder gets 0 where v0.7.3 kept the old balance

cases.selection: every USDT transaction with one call, and the four destroyBlackFunds transactions 261 to 264
cases.demonstrates: the owner Safe's destroyBlackFunds(holder) CALLs (call 2 of txs 261 to 264) each zero a blacklisted holder's balances word under base 2 and move _totalSupply (slot 1) by the same amount, with only the 1-topic DestroyedBlackFunds(holder, amount); the event explains each zeroing write, so the four holders get 0 where v0.7.3 kept their old balances (64,707,708.53, 2,903,914.21, 87,464,642.26 and 30,000,000.35 USDT)

cases.selection: every USDT transaction with one call, and the redeem transaction 269
cases.demonstrates: redeem(2,000,000,000 USDT) by the owner Safe 0xc6cde7c3... in tx 269 call 2 (Block.ver 5) moves the sender's balances word and _totalSupply by the amount, with only Redeem(amount); the sender is a candidate and the event explains its write, so the owner gets 108,983.767 USDT where v0.7.3 left 2,000,108,983.767

cases.selection: every USDT transaction (only the destroyBlackFunds transaction 31)
cases.demonstrates: a block whose only USDT frame is destroyBlackFunds(0x008fe405...) (tx 31 call 2): no Transfer flow, so the destruction frame votes base 2 and the holder gets 0; v0.7.3 inferred nothing

cases.selection: every USDT transaction (only the destroyBlackFunds transaction 56)
cases.demonstrates: a block whose only USDT frame is destroyBlackFunds(0x...18fe) (tx 56 call 2): no Transfer flow, so the destruction frame votes base 2 and the holder gets 0; v0.7.3 inferred nothing
